+    @isolate_apps('model_inheritance')
+    def test_parent_link_takes_precedence_over_other_onetoone(self):
+        # When a model declares multiple OneToOneFields to the same parent,
+        # the field with parent_link=True must be used as the MTI parent link,
+        # regardless of the order in which the fields are declared.
+        class Document(models.Model):
+            pass
+
+        class PickingParentFirst(Document):
+            document_ptr = models.OneToOneField(
+                Document, on_delete=models.CASCADE, parent_link=True, related_name='+',
+            )
+            origin = models.OneToOneField(
+                Document, related_name='picking', on_delete=models.PROTECT,
+            )
+
+        class PickingParentLast(Document):
+            origin = models.OneToOneField(
+                Document, related_name='picking2', on_delete=models.PROTECT,
+            )
+            document_ptr = models.OneToOneField(
+                Document, on_delete=models.CASCADE, parent_link=True, related_name='+',
+            )
+
+        for Picking in (PickingParentFirst, PickingParentLast):
+            self.assertIs(Picking._meta.parents[Document], Picking._meta.get_field('document_ptr'))
+            self.assertIs(Picking._meta.pk, Picking._meta.get_field('document_ptr'))
+            # The non parent_link field is still a regular relation.
+            self.assertFalse(Picking._meta.get_field('origin').primary_key)
+
     @isolate_apps('model_inheritance')
